This error usually occurs when a statement is incomplete, malformed, or non-existent.



'''Compatibility:'''

Version '''1.96'''



'''Example (non-existent statement):'''

7 + 6 * 5

'''Example (malformed statement):'''

3 = 4

'''Example (incomplete statement):'''

_myVariable
